title: Sharing: XHR/JS should not run if the button style is set to something w/o sharing counts
body:
<!-- Thanks for contributing to Jetpack! Pick a clear title ("Sharing: add new Facebook button") and proceed. -->
#### Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Turn on JetPack Sharing buttons and put Facebook button on the page
2. Set the Button Style to "Icon + Text".
3. Go to the blog home page
4. Observe network requests from DevTools
#### What I expected
1. No requests made to graph.facebook.com
#### What happened instead
1. 3 requests made to graph.facebook.com
#### Note

This can be workaround by adding a `jetpack_sharing_counts` filter, added back in 2004. However itself is a bug that should be corrected. 

It's a privacy issue too, since we are essentially ended up allowing Facebook to track it's user on every WordPress blog post s/he reads (assuming 3rd-party cookie is not blocked).
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: I am sorry. This issue is invalid. All button styles would have the sharing count show on the button; it just don't show when the sharing count is 0.
